source_standard: Kimball dimensional-modeling conventions (fact/dimension grain), https://www.kimballgroup.com/data-warehouse-business-intelligence-resources/kimball-techniques/dimensional-modeling-techniques/ — chosen at this delivery sub-batch's own re-scout per the batch-3-plus proposal's flagged gap; the Data Contract Specification (bitol.io) was considered and rejected because it duplicates data-engineering's dbt-contract scope within this repo's family split.

reference_resolution.rule: table_name must resolve to an actual modeled table definition — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-checking table_name's declared grain against its current column set, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a new fact or dimension table is proposed on the branch AND no data-modeling record exists yet for that table
